answer: The willow counter is kept in summit and ember makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 24 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Someone as a result has to keep each alias continuously active for 24 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4889 identities would post 1143 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
